scope: Additional targeted repair after parent observed first install recovery failures; not a formal unchanged-source audit round

findings.trigger: Initialization succeeds, candidate preparation fails, operator retries using update
findings.before: Only install enabled services, so successful update recovery did not enable boot startup
findings.fix: initialize writes a private pending installation record; Manager activate/restart persist healthy and complete phases around retryable enablement

findings.trigger: The first candidate fails health after current is selected; operator retries with the same or another source
findings.before: The retained current was treated as an already-active release; identical activation did nothing and another activation made the failed candidate previous
findings.fix: Confirmed failed first start clears current; unknown stop retains it. A pending installation never treats that pointer as a rollback target. Legacy first-start journals identify pre-marker failed candidates, and abandoned first-start transactions are retired only after confirmed stop

findings.trigger: A candidate with an already imported exact release digest is independently rebuilt during retry
findings.before: Publication rejected any existing release directory before activation could recover
findings.fix: Reuse only an exclusively root-owned real directory matching the complete new verified manifest and recorded manifest. Do not overwrite its contents. Reconstruct a missing manifest only from the independently rebuilt identical tree

findings.trigger: Operator install/update/control command throws after a mutation
findings.before: The outer CLI exception envelope incorrectly declared delivery not_sent
findings.fix: Outer operator exceptions omit delivery; gateway RPC and persistent operation receipts retain their existing boundary-based delivery fields

findings.trigger: A is healthy or complete; update B is interrupted after selection; update C starts before recovery
findings.before: The uncommitted B pointer became the next rollback target
findings.fix: activate and restart reject nonterminal management transactions until repair, except stop-confirmed recoverable first attempts with no healthy predecessor

findings.trigger: A/current and Z/previous; update B changes previous to A, then commit-record publication fails or the process exits
findings.before: Failure/repair restored current A but kept previous A, losing Z and making rollback a self-reference
findings.fix: Release journal snapshots oldPrevious before stop; automatic restoration and explicit repair restore both pointers. For older journals lacking the snapshot, recovery removes only a self-reference and does not invent the lost target

limitations: Local Windows fixtures substitute systemd commands and symlink creation/reading; Linux executes real symlink methods but has not been run by this agent
Parent owns all real 120 deployment and systemd acceptance; this agent performed no remote operations

Legacy installations with a committed release but no completion marker cannot distinguish a failed old enable step from an intentional operator disable, so automatic recovery preserves their current enablement
Duplicate verified candidate exports and all prior transaction/release data remain retained under the existing eight-candidate workspace budget
No paid inference, external MCP calls, personal runtime home or full repository test suite was used
Legacy journals without oldPrevious cannot reconstruct an already lost historical rollback pointer; only the invalid self-reference can be removed safely

independentNarrowReview.status: Both fixes independently confirmed; four related regression tests rerun and passed; no new issue in the narrow review
